ruleDefinitions.name: First-time Mouse Jiggler - Activity Simulator Process Detected
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the first-time execution of known mouse jiggler or activity simulation applications for a given user, which can be used to bypass inactivity detection or maintain presence.
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: First-time mouse jiggler - activity simulator process '${event.process_name}' detected with command line '${event.process_command_line}' on host '${event.src_host}' by user '${entity.user.source}'.
ruleDefinitions.trainOnCondition: activity_type = 'process-create' AND (containsAny(process_command_line, 'MoveMouse Installer.exe', 'Move Mouse Installer.exe', 'MouseJiggle.exe', 'Wiggler - The mouse moving app Installer.exe', 'Caffeine.exe', 'Insomnia.exe', 'StayAwake.exe', 'PreventTurnOff.exe', 'DontSleep.exe', 'NoSleep.exe', 'StatusHolder.exe', 'MouseClicker.exe') OR containsAny(process_command_line, 'Auto Mouse Jiggler Mover.app', 'Jiggler.app', 'Computer Mouse Jiggler.app', 'Mouse Shaker.app', 'Mouse Mover', 'pip install jiggler'))
